input: Back up all phone contacts to the cloud

gold.taskTitle: Back up all phone contacts to the cloud
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to back up all contacts stored on their phone to a cloud service for safekeeping or access across devices.

questions.title: What type of phone do you have, iPhone or Android?
questions.description: Identifying the phone's operating system determines which backup methods and cloud services are available.

questions.title: Which cloud service do you want to use?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred cloud platform (e.g., iCloud, Google, Samsung) guides the specific steps needed.

questions.title: Have you backed up contacts to this service before?
questions.description: Understanding whether this is a first-time setup or a routine backup affects the complexity of the steps involved.

questions.title: Are your contacts stored on the SIM, phone, or an existing account?
questions.description: The current storage location of contacts determines how they need to be exported or synced.

questions.title: Do you need contacts to sync automatically going forward?
questions.description: Knowing if the user wants a one-time backup or ongoing automatic sync shapes the solution recommended.

questions.title: How many contacts roughly are you trying to back up?
questions.description: The volume of contacts can affect the method chosen, especially for large exports or storage limits.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or urgency behind doing this now?
questions.description: Understanding urgency helps prioritize the task and flag whether a fast, simple method is preferred over a thorough one.
